Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Following ‘Qualifying Criteria’ provided hereunder shall supersede elsewhere pr ovided in the bid document, for evaluation purpose. 1. Experience Criteria and Past Performance: The Bidder or its OEM {them selves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products i.e. Supply, Installation, Testing & Com missioning (SITC) of Online Double Conversion UPS system of 30 KVA o r higher capacity, 3-Phase Input and 3-Phase Output, parallel redundant mode configuration UPS system to any Central / State Govt Org anization / PSU / Public Listed Company in at least one of the last 03 (three) Financial years or current financial year up to the last day of the month previous to one in which the bids are invited. Copies of relevant contracts and C ompletion Certificate is to be submitted along with bid.

In case, Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} have supplied sa me or similar Category Products to non-Government entity, the bidder shall req uire to submit relevant contracts / experience certificate issued by the non-Gov ernment entity along with notarized copy of Taxable invoice/ TDS certificate (if a pplicable) for corresponding value of contracts issued by the non-Government e ntity. 2. OEM Authorisation: The bidder shall submit OEM Authorisation of Online D ouble Conversion UPS System. Wherever Authorised Distributors/ service pr oviders are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/ Origin al Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Ph one No. required to be furnished along with the bid. In case of OEM Authorization Certificate, the bidders shall submit a valid Genera l Authorized Service Provider Certificate (without reference to specific tender) d uly signed by the authorized person and be properly stamped by the OEM. Tend er specific Authorization in favour of particular dealer/ bidder will not be entertai ned. 3. In the tender either the manufacturer or its authorised dealer can be consider ed as valid bidders. In case where the manufacturer has submitted the bid, the bids of its authorised dealer will not be considered. 4. Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years): The average a nnual financial Turnover of “the bidder” during the last three years, ending on 3 1st March 2026 should be Rs. 9 Lakh as per the Annual Report (Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss account) of the relevant period, duly authenticated by a Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant in India. 5. Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) bidders holding valid Udyam Registration and are manufacturer of the offered Product or Service shall be allowed exempti on from submission of EMD. As per MSE policy, dealers/ traders are outside the purview of benefits under MSE. Only manufacturer can avail benefits under MSE policy. If the bidder is a Start-up and registered for similar nature of work, is exempted from furnishing the EMD. 6. Exemption in Experience/ Past Performance criteria and Turnover criteria not given to MSEs and Start-up bidders.
